scope_classes.project_deployment: Selected service resources and runtime identities live in one supplied project.
scope_classes.resource_candidate: Bindings move to named deployment resources where Google IAM supports that scope.
scope_classes.bootstrap_excluded: Project creation, billing attachment, API enablement, and custom-role creation stay outside the retained deployment identity.
scope_classes.database_wide_poc_limit: Firestore IAM is database-wide; application contracts isolate the L3/L4 collection groups.

accepted_gaps: Project IAM mutation remains broad until resource-level bindings pass a supervised smoke.
Cloud Run worker pools are Preview, fixed-size, and non-autoscaling for the Large Six-layer scenario.
No organization, project-creation, or billing authority is retained.
activation_gates: gcloud list-testable-permissions accepts every custom-role input
worker-pool region and Terraform provider preflight succeeds when Large Six-layer is selected
direct Cloud Run IAP provider schema, service-agent invoker binding, and IAP policy permissions pass preflight
supervised deploy/destroy smoke records no missing permission
